preview: Barbados Tridents face Saint Lucia Kings in CPL 2026 Match 29 at Kensington Oval. The match is scheduled for Sun 6 Sep at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
